   - copy character-for-character vs §7 (incl. D-67 yearly caption and the singular "over 1 month").

   - performance: L-MAX with all charts — measure click → 1,200th row + 4 figures + next frame in each browser a few times.

4. Exploratory: 1-month, 13-month, 0%, 75%, 10^15 and 1,200-month loans; currency switch with charts shown; theme switch with a tooltip open; hover at the far left/right edges (tooltip stays inside, no page overflow); 180 px (200% zoom) and 360 px; forced-colors emulation (are chart marks still distinguishable? report).
5. Code quality (Minor unless it risks wrong figures, crashes or an a11y failure).

Turn REAL defects into failing `[REVIEW-n]` tests in e2e/review/ (typecheck-clean); delete probes that found nothing. End with `BLOCKING FINDINGS: <count>`. Do not edit src/ or any frozen test.

- **Three gaps in the proposal, closed with the developer's suggestions** (the owner approved without separate answers, so the suggestions stand):
  1. the yearly chart's `<figcaption>` is `Interest and principal paid each year.` (new copy key `yearly.chart.caption`);

- **Test-designer readings** (binding with the tests):
  - the results card is the smallest ancestor holding the summary, the four figures and the schedule;
  - "chart text" means every element with its own visible text inside a `<figure>`, plus the four chart titles (tooltips excluded);
  - marks must resolve to a solid colour (fill, else stroke, else `background-color`);
  - a 0%-interest cost bar may omit the interest segment, or make it at most 0.5 px wide;
  - each hoverable figure has exactly one `[data-hit-area]`;
  - the tooltip is the single page-level `role="tooltip"` after a hover;
  - the legend order is the document order of the exact texts `Principal` and `Interest`;
  - yearly cells are read as `th, td`;

- **Still open:** D-64 (redesign gate) and RD-3 (forced-colors borders).

### D-68 Visuals implementation (Proposed, owner to review at the visuals mini-gate)
1. **Domain:** `costSplit`, `interestShare` and `yearlySummary` in `src/domain/summary.ts`, and `formatPercent` in `format.ts`. All use exact `Decimal` arithmetic with half-up rounding to 1 dp; `loanPercent` is `100 − interestPercent`.
2. **Geometry:** every chart uses one band layout. Item *k* of *n* spans [*k*/*n*, (*k*+1)/*n*] of the plot, centred where the D-66 hover hook expects it.
   - The balance and payment charts are **stepped areas**, one `<path>` per series however many months there are. The yearly chart is **bars**, again one `<path>` per series.
   - The SVG stretches to the card (`preserveAspectRatio="none"`). **All text is HTML** (caption, legend, axis ends, tooltip), so nothing scales down to unreadable sizes on phones.
3. **No money becomes a JS `number`.** Drawing needs a dimensionless ratio (value ÷ max), computed in `Decimal` and converted with `toNumber()` only for pixel geometry. The cost bar's flex weights are the two *percentages*, which are not money.
4. **Palette,** checked with the dataviz validator script against the real card surfaces (all checks pass: lightness band, chroma, colour-blind separation ΔE ≥ 25, normal-vision ΔE ≥ 25, ≥ 3:1 against the surface):
   - light: Principal `#6A50D3` (the design's focus colour), Interest `#C4512E`;
   - dark: Principal `#957EEC`, Interest `#D4703C`.
   - The **balance** (and the cost bar's **loan amount**) use the Principal colour: the balance *is* the principal still owed, and a teal tried first failed the chroma and colour-blind checks.
5. **No new words beyond the approved copy.** The axes show only the first and last item numbers (`1` … `120`).
6. **No new keyboard stops:** the charts aren't focusable, and the yearly table isn't a scroll region, so AC-8.1's frozen tab order is unchanged. Keyboard and screen-reader users get every value from the captions and tables. The tooltips are pointer-only, as §8.3.2 allows.
7. **Evidence:**
   - Vitest **345 of 345**.
   - The four visual specs **90 of 90** across 3 browsers on the first full run.
   - Full `CI=1 npm run verify`: the first run gave 542 of 543, with one WebKit 8-second click timeout in `[AC-2.16]`, a test that renders no chart. That test then passed 5 of 5 alone in WebKit, and the **second full run exited 0 with E2E 543 of 543** and `trace` OK. This matches the earlier load-only WebKit timeouts (D-64).
   - Bundle 87.1 KB (it was 85.4 KB).

### D-69 Sticky loan form (owner request, 2026-10-18)
- **Request:** the owner's screenshots showed the empty space under the form while scrolling the results: "freeze the actual calculator … when you scroll the space on left is empty".
- **Decision:** at **≥ 769 px wide and ≥ 820 px tall**, the form card is `position: sticky` (`top: 24px`) and follows the scroll. In shorter windows it scrolls normally, so the bottom of the form (Calculate) can never end up out of reach. Phones and tablets keep the single column.
- **One wrapper `<div className="layout-main">`** now holds the form and the results. A sticky element can travel to the end of its parent box, and with the whole layout grid as parent, the form **overlapped Saved calculations** at the end of the page (probe: form bottom 568 px against the card top at 511 px). The wrapper has no role or semantics and changes no order. With it, the form stops at the end of the results (form bottom 487 px against the card top at 511 px) in Chromium, Firefox and WebKit.
- **Not done:** no sticky behaviour on short windows. The 820 px threshold leaves room for the form with all three error messages showing.

/**
 * Validate a categorical chart palette against the computable data-viz checks.
 *
 * Design-system-agnostic: feed it ANY palette's hex values plus the mode and
 * surface, and it computes - never eyeballs - the five checks that can be
 * measured from color alone:
 *
 *   2. Lightness band   - OKLCH L within the mode's band
 *   3. Chroma floor     - OKLCH C >= floor (below it a hue reads as gray)
 *   4. CVD separation   - OKLab Delta E (×100) between slots under simulated protan/deutan
 *                         (tritan reported); adjacent pairs by default, pairs:"all"
 *                         for scatter/bubble/maps
 *   4b. Normal-vision floor - worst OKLab Delta E (×100) on the active pairlist
 *       (adjacent by default; all pairs with --pairs all) under unsimulated vision;
 *                         full-color readers must be able to tell neighbors apart too
 *   5. Contrast vs surface - WCAG ratio of each mark against the chart surface
 *
 * Checks 1 (fixed hue order) and 6 (values are from the documented palette) are
 * structural rules the skill enforces, not measurable from hexes alone.
 *
 * Usage (node):
 *   node validate_palette.js "#2a78d6,#eb6834,#1baf7a,#eda100,#e87ba4,#008300,#6250d6,#e34948" --mode light
 *   node validate_palette.js "#256abf,#199e70,..." --mode dark --surface "#1a1a19"
 *   node validate_palette.js "#86b6ef,#5598e7,#256abf,#104281" --ordinal
 *
 * Usage (browser - as a module script):
 *   <body data-palette="#2a78d6,#eb6834,..." data-mode="light">
 *   <script type="module" src="validate_palette.js"></script>
 *   -> logs a console.table of the report and console.warn on any FAIL.
 *
 * Exit code 0 unless a check hard-FAILs; 1 on any FAIL. WARN bands do not fail:
 * adjacent CVD in the 6-8 floor band, and contrast in the sub-3:1 relief band,
 * are reported as WARNs and still exit 0 (each is legal only with mandatory
 * secondary encoding: direct labels, gaps, or texture). The normal-vision floor
 * is a hard gate: a worst unsimulated pair below 15 FAILs the run.
 */

// -- thresholds ----------------------------------------------------------------
const BAND = { light: [0.43, 0.77], dark: [0.48, 0.67] }; // OKLCH L
const CHROMA_FLOOR = 0.10; // OKLCH C
// Delta E is Euclidean distance in OKLab ×100. The CVD thresholds are calibrated to
// the Machado-Oliveira-Fernandes (2009) severity-1.0 simulation below - the sim
// model is part of the standard, not an implementation detail (swapping in e.g.
// Viénot-1999 moves borderline pairs and would require recalibrating these).
const CVD_TARGET = 8.0, CVD_FLOOR = 6.0; // OKLab Delta E×100, min(protan, deutan), adjacent pairs
const NORMAL_FLOOR = 15.0; // OKLab Delta E×100, worst pair on the active pairlist, unsimulated vision
const CONTRAST_MIN = 3.0; // WCAG vs surface
const DEFAULT_SURFACE = { light: "#fcfcfb", dark: "#1a1a19" };
const ORDINAL_MIN_DL = 0.06; // min OKLCH delta L between adjacent steps
const ORDINAL_LIGHT_FLOOR = 2.0; // lightest step: WCAG contrast vs surface

### 8.3.2 Charts (D-65)

- **Order inside the results card:**
  1. the three figures and the rounding note;
  2. **Cost breakdown** (S-20);
  3. **Balance over time** (S-21);
  4. **Interest and principal in each payment** (S-22);
  5. **Yearly summary**, a chart and table (S-19);
  6. the **Repayment schedule**, still last.
- **Hand-built inline SVG,** drawn from `CalculatedLoan`. No chart library (§2) and no network.
- **Each series is one `<path>`,** never one element per month, so 1,200 months stay within AC-10.8.
- **Never colour alone:**
  - every chart has a visible text summary (its `<figcaption>`);
  - two-series charts have an HTML legend, with Principal first and Interest second in every chart;
  - the data is also in a table (the schedule, the yearly table).
- **Colour:** two categorical series in a fixed order, validated with the dataviz validator against the light and dark card surfaces. Marks reach at least 3:1 against `--surface`, and chart text uses the text tokens (AC-20.5).
- **One y-axis per chart.** Axes and grid are quiet.
- **Hover:** a pointer tooltip (`role="tooltip"`) on the balance, payment and yearly charts, with the exact values. Keyboard and screen-reader users get the same values from the tables.
- **Layout:** fluid width with no fixed pixel widths, and no horizontal page scroll (AC-20.6).

### 8.4 Theme

Resolved theme = the user's choice, or `prefers-color-scheme` when set to `system`. Apply it as `data-theme="light|dark"` on `<html>`. A tiny inline script in `index.html` applies the saved theme before first paint (wrapped in try/catch) so there is no flash of the wrong theme. Listen for `matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)')` changes while `system` is selected.

Starting tokens. Tests must prove ≥ 4.5:1 for these text pairs in both themes: text/bg, text/surface, text-muted/bg, text-muted/surface, error/bg, error/surface, on-primary/primary. Failures return `{ ok: false }` and are never thrown to the UI. If storage is unavailable: settings work in memory for the visit (AC-6.6), and history shows `history.unavailable` (AC-11.9).
